svg.title: SO-101 and MX Keys: fitted training scene, 2026-09-17
svg.desc: Model projection, not verified physical fixture measurements. X points from the robot toward the keyboard; Y points left. D is a CAD base datum. Q, P and Z mark model keycap rim centres.
svg.text: SO-101 → MX Keys | fitted training scene, 2026-09-17
Effective simulation placement after contact fitting • keep the measured real fixture fixed
Model keycap rim centres relative to D (X, Y, Z mm)
K = keyboard CAD origin (not a ruler datum)
D in robot CAD frame: (64.635, 0.000, -2.400) mm
Z = height above the plastic base underside plane.
Clamp/table height is not automatically this zero plane.
Q/P/Z: centre of the key outline at its top rim, keys released; not the recessed bowl.
Scene: replay-calibrated-20260917.json • offsets and physical qualification: see the calibration guide.
